description: Update a prompt label's name, description, or color only, unlike update_prompt_version which changes which label a version carries. This takes effect immediately for all versions already tagged with the label, but does not reassign labels or touch history; use list_prompt_labels to find the label_id first.
name: update_prompt_label

data.description: Structured success payload when ok is true

error.description: Structured error payload when ok is false

ok.description: Whether the tool call succeeded and returned structured data
